Behavior.InstillEnergy_HasteAllowsSickAt.reason: Oracle haste lets the sick enchanted creature attack. Instill Energy only clears STATE_SUMMON_SICK (0x20000); nothing ever clears STATE_SUMMONSICK_NOATTACK (0x10000), whose own design note says it is temporarily removable with haste or Instill Energy. The attack guard therefore still rejects the hasted creature. Correct haste expectations remain intact. Confirmed natively and in Wasm; production fix deferred.
